intro: Sentinel Selarin is a night elf scout dispatched to the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Acting as an emissary for the defenders of Ashenvale, she seeks reinforcements to help stem the rising perils threatening the ancient forest.

p: As tensions and dark threats mount across Ashenvale, the garrison there has found its resources stretched to the breaking point. Under the direction of Raene Wolfrunner, Sentinel Selarin traveled north along the forest road into Darkshore. Her mission was straightforward: seek out Terenthis in Auberdine and request assistance from the sentinels and scouts stationed on the coast.

Upon arriving in Auberdine, Selarin found Terenthis thoroughly consumed by local duties and unable to personally answer the call. Rather than returning empty-handed, Selarin resolved to remain in town and enlist capable travelers passing through Darkshore. She directs proven adventurers south toward Astranaar, urging them to lend their blades and spells to Raene Wolfrunner's beleaguered forces.
